name: unknown-part-in-message-list
description: an unrecognised element inside a list is dropped and the list survives: a user message whose content array carries a future part kind between two text parts keeps both text parts
kill: make stripAgainst's ZodArray branch propagate DROP outward instead of skipping the element — the whole message, and with it both conformant text parts, then disappears from the snapshot

dotnet.intentional: the known TS/.NET asymmetry, the same shape as unknown-outcome-stripped: .NET's input-content converter is a closed union, so an unrecognised part inside a message list is a fatal JsonException rather than stripped material — and being fatal, it is thrown rather than warned about. `warnings` is emptied only to displace the base expectation; `noWarnings` asserts that the rejection says nothing on the warning channel.
